title: G-Town
description: A daft pseudo-3D (2.5D) open-world driving toy built from real OpenStreetMap data, with Lua and LOVE2D.
description_html: A daft pseudo-3D (2.5D) open-world driving toy built from real OpenStreetMap data, with Lua and LOVE2D. Drive around a real city centre with extruded buildings and a rotating camera.
features: Real city geometry — streets and buildings from OpenStreetMap
2.5D rendering — oblique perspective with extruded buildings, depth-sorted
Rotating camera — heading-up movement with full camera rotation
Driveable vehicles — take cars and bikes, drive around the city
Web build — plays in the browser via love.js (WASM)
